title: Show HN: HackerTV – HN's most-recommended Youtube videos as 24/7 TV channels
author: dsalzman
description: I saw HackerTube ( https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50319510 ) a few days ago, the YouTube videos HN keeps recommending, pulled from 19 years of comments.
